entities.name: Minamoto no Shigeyuki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Minamoto no Shigeyuki was an early Heian waka poet and nobleman. He was designated a member of the Thirty-six Poetry Immortals and one of his poems is included in the famous anthology Hyakunin Isshu. His remaining works include a poetry collection known as the Shigeyukishū (重之集).
